review.finding: .mc-file-plain glued onto the same line as .mc-file span rule, trailing newline lost; font-size .9em is relative (12px floor).
No in-flight de-duplication; unknown answers never cached so remounts re-probe and can hit 429; cache never evicted.
review.suggestion: Per-task inflight map; short negative cache for unknown; cap/sweep cache.

review.finding: flush() awaits chunks/tasks sequentially, no fetch timeout; a hung request leaves chips pending.
Evidence batching covers only absolute outside paths; lexicallyInside startsWith('..') false-positive for names like ..foo (harmless).
No oracle or guard weakening found. Rate-limit map never pruned; call counted before body validation.
review.suggestion: Delete empty keys; optionally count after validation.

review.finding: After cache expiry the hook keeps returning stale asked answer and never re-probes (a no stays no until remount).
review.suggestion: Honour expiry in asked and re-probe.
